rule: Each scenario has ordered checks sharing its weight equally. A scenario scores 0 on crash/hang/timeout. Partial credit applies per check, never by reweighting after results.

categories.why: Nothing else runs without a healthy launch.
Primary v1 entry point; must reject safely.
Core machine analysis must be stable.
Reviewer spends most time here; state bugs bite hardest.
The v1 grounding joint; must work without typing.
Flagship output; failures must be clean.
Failures must be recoverable and honest.
Adversarial inputs must not corrupt state.
